name: John H.
text: I couldn't be happier with the work done by VB Build. They recently completed several home repairs and improvements for us, and the results are outstanding. His craftsmanship is top-notch, and you can tell he takes great pride in his work. What really stood out to me was his professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail. He listens carefully, offers smart suggestions, and makes sure everything is done right — no shortcuts. He's hardworking, honest, and brings the strong work ethic you always hope to find in a contractor. If you need high-quality home construction or repair work, don't hesitate to reach out to him. I'm very impressed and will definitely be using his services again. A true 5-star experience!

name: Mike
text: VB Build exceeded my expectations in every way! From start to finish, the entire experience was professional, efficient, and top-quality. Communication was clear, the pricing was fair, and every detail was handled with real craftsmanship. The standout part of the project was the tile installation. The floors are flawless — so precise and smooth that you can slide a credit card across the tiles without hitting a single bump. That level of skill and attention to detail is rare, and it shows every time I walk into the room. If you're looking for a handyman who truly takes pride in his work, look no further than VB Build. I highly recommend them and will definitely be using their services again!

name: Frank G.
text: VB Build did an awesome job on my floors. They worked quickly, the quality came out great, and the price was very reasonable. Really happy with the results and I'd definitely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable work.

name: Seimur
text: This guys are amazing, real professionals, I'm so glad I meet you guys thank you again also very fair price !!!

name: Ina Rez
text: I recently hired VBBuild LLC for a renovation project, and the results exceeded my expectations in every way. From start to finish, their team demonstrated outstanding professionalism, clear communication, and exceptional craftsmanship. The project was completed on schedule, within budget, and with remarkable attention to detail. The owner was respectful, skilled, and dedicated to delivering high-quality work. He took the time to explain each step of the process, offered helpful recommendations, and ensured the final outcome matched exactly what I envisioned. The workmanship is truly top-notch—precise, clean, and built to last. It’s clear that Volodymyr takes great pride in the quality of his work, and it shows in every part of the renovation. I highly recommend VBBuild LLC to anyone seeking reliable, professional, and high-quality renovation services. I wouldn’t hesitate to work with him again on future projects. Thank you!
